problem_text:
A logistics firm must coordinate the distribution of critical supplies to twelve distinct regional depots, whose geographic positions are given by the following coordinate pairs:
Depot Alpha: Positioned at (33,161)
Depot Beta: Positioned at (127,27)
Depot Gamma: Positioned at (157,6)
Depot Delta: Positioned at (134,152)

Due to infrastructural limitations, no direct transport link exists between Depot Alpha and Depot Beta. Furthermore, owing to a critical maintenance schedule, the routing plan must incorporate exactly one of the following two essential corridors: the link between Depot Beta and Depot Gamma, or the link between Depot Gamma and Depot Delta.

The objective is to determine the most efficient possible circuit that services each depot precisely once before concluding at the initial point of departure.
